verdict.rationale: 1Password documents several programmatic surfaces. Connect Servers expose a REST API for items and vaults, the official SDKs (Go, JavaScript, Python) support programmatic item management, and the Events API retrieves account activity. Service accounts and the scriptable op CLI round this out, and the SDK appears as an official GitHub repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end; the REST surface is a self-hosted Connect server rather than a hosted public endpoint.
